The test suite passes again: 17 passed, 0 failed.

**Cause:** `tax()` in `invoicing/pricing.py` charged tax on the full subtotal. Its own docstring, and two tests, say tax applies after the discount. So the 200.00 UK invoice with PARTNER25 got 40.00 tax instead of 30.00. The total came out at 190.00 instead of 180.00.

**Fix:** `tax()` now uses `subtotal - discount` as the taxable base. That is the only line I changed. I left the finance-owned `rates.py` and the tests alone. The only other caller of this pricing code is `render.py`, which just reads `total()`, so it needed no change.
